# Fonts in the desktop app

`abyssal-warden-gui` embeds the default fonts of egui (crate
`epaint_default_fonts` 0.35.0). They keep their own licences, which allow
bundling and embedding in software provided each copy carries the
copyright notice and licence text, so these files ship with every build of
the app.

| Font file | Licence | Licence text |
|---|---|---|
| `Hack-Regular.ttf` (Source Foundry Authors; derived from DejaVu and Bitstream Vera) | MIT; Bitstream Vera License | `Hack-Regular.txt` |
| `NotoEmoji-Regular.ttf` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `OFL.txt` |
| `Ubuntu-Light.ttf` | Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 | `UFL.txt` |
| `emoji-icon-font.ttf` (John Slegers) | MIT | `emoji-icon-font-mit-license.txt` |

Holders are named only where the licence file names them.
Copied unchanged from the crate's `fonts/` directory.
